notes.title: PatchNote 1.21 - Bug Fixes & Polishing & Nukes!!!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/A04I7V0.gif[/img]

Hello there,

We made a few bug fixes and improvements. Apologies for the issues in the previous patch. 

[b]1. Nuclear launch detected[/b]
-Earning Doomsday trophy is much cooler now! If you're lucky enough to destroy the nuclear powerplant, you'll see the surprise...

[b]2. Crane Mode is now easier again.[/b]
-There are no more gray containers in the Crane Mode. The previous patch made is too difficult, so we rolled back the change.

[b]3. Leaderboard are now subdivided into levels[/b]
-Each level has its own Leaderboards now. The original total score Leaderboard is still there at the mode (Crane / Hand) selection menu. 
-This made some original records hidden from the total score Leaderboard. This will be restored as those players play the game. Meanwhile, I'm looking for a way to fix that shortly.

[b]4. Fixed Leaderboard / Achievement bugs[/b]
-Leaderboards scores were recorded a bit higher. This is fixed.
-There were some Achievements not working. All of them are working now.

If you see any issue with the patch, please comment here or send email to jkim@handmadegame.net

Thanks!

-Jake, HandMade Game

notes.title: Hand Mode is updated + Many fixes / changes!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26412321/cc656dd6a8c821465f9400f356b15d22e12f9066.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

We've just updated the Hand Mode, where you can play with your hands, tweaked the game balance a bit, and polished some issues. Here are the details.

1. Hand Mode (Vive controller-only)
-Native Vive controller-only mode, where you use your hands to push blocks, instead of a crane. It has separate 16 levels with tweaked physics and game balance. 
-Using hands may sound easy, maybe or maybe not :)

2. Tweaked Game Balance
-We've been hearing some complaints that the game is too difficult, so we've adjusted the game balance a bit. 
-New containers are unlocked later. Previously, 1-2 had an explosive container. Now, the explosive container is unlocked at 2-1. 1-2 is a basic mode with 5 colors.
-Lowered Rubber Container friction a bit
-Mixed mode has less special containers

3. Local Multiplayer guidance polished
-When a turn is passed and you need to switch headset, we added an instruction to "Switch Headset"
-The ball changes color based on current turn's player color now.

4. Fixed bugs/issues with Vive controller
-Press trigger to skip a Trophy Unlock Alarm
-The tutorial shows correct text when you use Vive controllers
-"Reorient" workrs with Trigger button

*Regarding the Vive controller, A is Trigger & B is Grip, we're still thinking of the better way to put this within the game. 

Thanks!

-Jake
